title: Celebrating Digital Literacy & Achievement
summary: On 1st October, 2026, the Inner Wheel Club of Bombay celebrated a significant milestone in its Digital Literacy Project by felicitating 35 students who successfully completed their courses and received NIIT certificates.
description:
On 1st October, 2026, the Inner Wheel Club of Bombay celebrated a significant milestone in its Digital Literacy Project by felicitating 35 students who successfully completed their courses and received NIIT certificates. The event was graced by Chief Guest Shreyaan Daga,
whose inspiring address encouraged students to continue learning, embrace technology and strive for excellence. The programme was made possible through the valuable contributions of donors, mentors, volunteers and teachers, whose continued support has been instrumental in the initiative’s success. The felicitation was a proud and memorable occasion for the Club, reaffirming its commitment to education, digital empowerment and creating opportunities for a brighter future.
